card.name: Prepositions before autoimmune disease names
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "for" and "with" right before a named autoimmune disease or biologic drug (Crohn's, psoriatic arthritis, infliximab), mostly in biologic drug labels.

modes.label: Trial or dosage phrases
modes.description: "for" or "with" after "trials", "subjects" or "Dosage", just before a disease or drug name.
